summary: Neff Gaming showcases an elite universal speedrun team capable of clearing three major dungeons—Heretical Ruins, Grave of Rot, and Grave of Curse—in as fast as 4 to 8 seconds. The team consists of Nissa, Anneliesis, Astaion, Guinavivre, and Kurvida. Key synergy involves placing Anneliesis directly behind Nissa to accelerate her recharge speed, allowing Nissa (especially at Inspiration 5) to cast her ultimate in just 3 seconds. The setup relies on Attack sharing, Elite's Key, Angelic Alliance, and consumable food providing Lightning damage and Attack.

tips: Position Anneliesis directly behind Nissa to accelerate her ultimate cooldown.
Equip Astaion with Elite's Key and build maximum Attack for stat-sharing.
Equip Kurvida with Angelic Alliance and Guinavivre with the Bell artifact.
Build Nissa with the Puppeteer set and high Accuracy.
Consume food that buffs Lightning Damage and Attack before attempting speedruns.
